lead.event: Prabowo directs mining permits to deliver at least 70% of benefits to the state
lead.headline: Prabowo directs mining permits to deliver at least 70% of benefits to the state
lead.blurb: The Palace says the instruction does not require the government to receive 70% of mining production or net profit. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas warns that uncertainty over implementation raises concerns about higher royalties, additional levies and changes in mining-company ownership, which could increase costs, pressure margins and delay investment. Investors will watch for technical rule clarity, issuer responses and foreign flows in commodity stocks.

macro_flows.event: Indonesia's 10-year SBN yield reaches its highest level since 2020
macro_flows.headline: Indonesia's 10-year SBN yield reaches around 7.79%, highest since 2020
macro_flows.blurb: The 10-year US Treasury yield fell 10.2 basis points to 4.94%, while Indonesia’s 1-year SBN yield rose 13.5 basis points to 7.12%, widening the spread over Treasuries to 285 basis points. Investors are concerned that a possible MSCI reclassification could trigger up to US$4.9 billion in outflows, alongside fiscal deficit pressures and domestic political uncertainty.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: CDIA begins a share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: CDIA begins share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The program covers up to 4 billion shares, or 3.2% of issued shares, at a maximum price of Rp800 each. Chandra Daya Investasi will fund it gradually from internal cash, with Trimegah Sekuritas Indonesia executing the buyback through 22 February 2027; the company says it will not materially affect operations.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Prodia completes a Rp112.42 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PRDA completes Rp112.42 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Prodia repurchased 36.14 million shares at an average Rp3,033 each from 20 August to 19 November, equal to 3.85% of paid-in capital. It now holds 83.86 million shares from buybacks, or 8.95% of paid-in capital.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bumi Atsiri Prima prepares IPO and outlines proceeds allocation
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Bumi Atsiri Prima plans IPO to raise up to Rp101.46 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bumi Atsiri Prima plans to issue up to 534 million new shares, equal to 25.02% of post-offering capital, at Rp135-190 each. Net proceeds will fund working capital, with 70% for patchouli oil, 20% for nutmeg oil and 10% for massoia bark. Bookbuilding runs 23 to 25 November, with listing planned for 9 December.

deals_control.event: Energi Mega Persada completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.headline: ENRG completes US$200 million investment in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada bought newly issued Series A 6% perpetual convertible preferred stock, alongside Danantara Investment Management’s separate US$250 million purchase. The investment is expected to add approximately 47 million BOE of economic exposure after conversion, and each partner may appoint one director to HighPeak’s board.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: ENRG's investment is expected to add approximately 47 million BOE of economic exposure after conversion.

deals_control.event: Bara Sejahtera Abadi becomes controlling shareholder of Harum Energy
deals_control.headline: Bara Sejahtera Abadi takes control of HRUM with 50.092% of voting rights
deals_control.blurb: Bara Sejahtera Abadi acquired 6.759 billion shares at Rp660 each on 19 November, lifting its voting rights from 0.092% to 50.092%. Harum Energy says the transfer from Karunia Bara Perkasa was part of an internal group restructuring, with management and company policies unchanged.

deals_control.event: Sinarmas affiliate acquires an 18.13% stake in Ketrosden
deals_control.headline: Sinarmas affiliate acquires 18.13% stake in KETR
deals_control.blurb: Inti Mas Bangun Sejahtera paid Rp65.94 billion to buy 515.19 million shares from Fajar Sejahtera Mandiri Nusantara on 17 November at Rp128 per share. Its stake rose to 53.13%, while Fajar Sejahtera no longer holds control of KETR.

other.event: PP Presisi reports Rp1.7 trillion in new contracts through Q3 2026
other.headline: PPRE reports Rp1.7 trillion in new contracts through Q3 2026
other.blurb: PP Presisi posted a net loss of Rp161.61 billion, versus net profit of Rp104.97 billion a year earlier. Mining and construction services accounted for 98% of the contracts, while revenue rose 20.1% to Rp3.33 trillion.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: PPRE posted a net loss of Rp161.61 billion through Q3 2026, versus net profit of Rp104.97 billion a year earlier.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI considers alternatives to Indonesia downgrade after Prabowo call
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI considers Indonesia downgrade alternatives after Prabowo's over-one-hour call
market_structure_policy.blurb: MSCI is maintaining freezes on FIF, NOS, additions to its Indonesia Investable Market Index and capitalization-segment increases. It said it would consider alternatives after Prabowo spoke with CEO Henry Fernandez on 10 November. Indonesia has until 30 April 2027 to submit feedback, with a final classification decision due by 30 June.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 6 new articles with a new fact: MSCI is maintaining freezes on FIF, NOS, additions to the MSCI Indonesia IMI and capitalization-segment increases.

earnings_guidance.event: JPMorgan downgrades BBCA and cuts its target price to Rp4,800
earnings_guidance.headline: JPMorgan downgrades BBCA, cuts target price to Rp4,800
earnings_guidance.blurb: Its previous target was Rp5,900, cut in early November ahead of the 20 November downgrade. JPMorgan cited foreign-flow concerns as BCA’s MSCI Emerging Markets weight fell from 0.50% to 0.15%. Kiwoom’s Kevin Yudha Pratama maintained a BUY rating and Rp7,150 target.

earnings_guidance.event: Panin Sekuritas issues indicative targets for ASII, AUTO and DRMA
earnings_guidance.headline: Panin Sekuritas sets targets of Rp7,100, Rp4,200 and Rp1,560 for ASII, AUTO, DRMA
earnings_guidance.blurb: Analyst Elandry Pratama sees positive prospects through 2027, citing recovering domestic sales and rising hybrid and EV production. He recommends gradual accumulation on healthy corrections and views ASII as more attractive for medium-to-long-term investment.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Tabungan Negara reports Q3 profit decline as broker maintains Buy rating
earnings_guidance.headline: BBTN reports 68% Q3 profit decline as broker keeps Buy rating
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Tabungan Negara’s Q3 net profit fell to Rp420 billion as its cost of funds rose 93 basis points to 4.2% and cost of credit reached 1.4%. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Victor Stefano maintained a Buy rating with a Rp1,500 target price and raised 2026–2028 profit forecasts by 1%, 3% and 5%.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Neo Commerce reports nine-month profit and strengthens business strategy
earnings_guidance.headline: BBYB reports Rp430.98 billion profit and reinforces strategy
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Neo Commerce’s net interest income rose for three straight quarters to Rp576.04 billion in Q3, while nine-month fee income increased 5.67% year on year to Rp90.55 billion. It plans to optimize consumer lending and wealth management, expand partnerships and develop AI-based financial-planning tools.

flash.event: Bayan Resources reshuffles board after Jhonlin Baratama's major stake acquisition
flash.headline: Bayan Resources (BYAN) shareholders approved a board reshuffle after Jhonlin acquired a 30.25% stake
flash.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: Shareholders approved the board changes on 23 November, appointing Ary Bastari as president director in place of Low Tuck Kwong.

flash.headline: PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk (BTPN) plans to delist voluntarily and go private as trading is suspended
